purpose: The 7 independent code-audit findings from this phase's own charter, frozen as mandatory Part A work items regardless of 3F.1.6.R's own self-reported PASS.

findings.title: Trusted semantic IR is not durably persisted
findings.requiredOutcome: A durable, versioned, reloadable semantic-truth persistence layer for compiled/verified IR (rules/definitions), with full provenance, tenant isolation, and trust-status gating.

findings.title: AnalysisRun concurrency claim is racy
findings.requiredOutcome: Atomic ownership/claim mechanism (real Postgres coordination, not process-local mutex); proven with real concurrent callers.

findings.title: Partial instrument failure can disappear
findings.requiredOutcome: Durable, visible trust state for every material instrument-level failure; the final AnalysisRun status must distinguish full success from partial analysis with unresolved failure.

findings.title: BLOCKER-8 is only partially remediated (same-family/same-role/same-node collision)
findings.requiredOutcome: Generalized, source-grounded claim identity that does not conflate distinct propositions sharing family/role/node.

findings.title: ContractRule backfill format check is not enough
findings.requiredOutcome: Referential-integrity verification (not just key-shape check) for every repaired definedTermRefs entry; fix coupled DefinedTermNode staleness if it blocks correctness.

findings.title: Live application entry is real but must verify actual user flow inevitability
findings.requiredOutcome: Proof (or fix) that a real user cannot reach the product's 'analyzed' state without the authoritative contract-analysis path having run.

findings.title: Unexpected pre-analysis error can be log-only
findings.requiredOutcome: Every contract-analysis failure path, including before AnalysisRun ownership is established, must produce durable state, not console-log-only evidence.

workstreamAssignment.B: BLOCKERS 2-6 (operative/supersession revalidation + fix any real bypass).
workstreamAssignment.H: BLOCKER-10 + AUDIT-F1, F2, F3, F6, F7 (live trust path, durable persistence, concurrency, partial failure, product-flow inevitability, no log-only failure) - the critical path, bundled into one workstream since all 5 items touch the same tightly-coupled orchestrator/persistence surface.
